# Magnolia Gardens Landscaping

> Residential lawn care and landscaping in Kingsport, Tennessee, serving the Tri-Cities. Licensed and insured. Text a photo of your yard to 423-390-9954 for a fast quote (typically the same day), or get an instant price at https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/estimate/

Owner-operated by Sean Price. Sullivan County business license, general liability insured. Take the lawn off your to-do list.

## Services

- [Recurring mowing](https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/services/mowing/): weekly or biweekly visits with mow, trim, edge, and blow-off
- [Cleanups](https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/services/cleanup/): seasonal and overgrowth cleanups, quoted from photos, typically the same day
- [Maintenance](https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/services/maintenance/): ongoing property upkeep beyond the mow
- [Mulch and beds](https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/services/mulch/): bed refresh, mulch installs, and plantings
- [Brush clearing](https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/services/brush-clearing/): heavy growth cut back to usable yard

## Fall 2026

- [Leaf removal](https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/services/cleanup/): single pass or a 3-visit season package depending on your trees, quoted from photos, typically the same day
- [Fall cleanup](https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/services/cleanup/): leaves, beds, overgrowth, and the last tall mow of the year, finished to before-and-after proof photos
- [Aeration and overseeding](https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/services/cleanup/#aeration): September through mid-October, the one window that matters for fescue lawns in Northeast Tennessee
- Bed renovation, edging, and pre-spring mulch
- Spring 2027 reservation: $75 holds a spot on the spring 2027 route, credited in full to the first spring visit, with the quoted rate locked through June 2027

## Pricing, published on purpose

- $50 minimum visit. Instant Standard / Full-service pricing at https://magnoliagardenslandscaping.com/estimate/
- One flat per-visit price per property, set by lot size and how often we come. Weekly is the best per-visit rate; biweekly is priced higher because two weeks of growth makes a longer, heavier visit. Published ranges are weekly. No tier ladder.
- Standard-visit anchors by lot size: compact $50, mid $85, spacious $125, estate $180. Full-service (adds bed care and detail work) runs about 1.5x. The exact number is confirmed at the property before any work starts.
- Addresses on or near an existing route day can land at the low end of a range — route density is what makes the $50 entry real.
- Overgrown or long-neglected lawns are quoted by condition from photos
- Projects over $500: 50% deposit, balance on completion

## Frequently asked

- What does lawn care cost in Kingsport? Standard mowing starts at a $50 minimum and typically runs about $50–$190 per visit weekly, set by lot size and how often we come. Cleanups, leaf removal, and overgrown lawns are quoted from photos, typically the same day.
- When should I aerate and overseed in Kingsport? September through mid-October, the fescue window for Northeast Tennessee. Spring seeding fights heat and weeds.
- How does leaf removal pricing work? Quoted from photos, typically the same day. One pass or a 3-visit season package depending on your trees.
- Do you apply chemicals or fertilizer? No. We also don't fell trees, grind stumps, repair irrigation or hardscape, clean gutters, or remove snow. We'll point you to a local pro who does.
- Do I have to be home? No. If we can access the yard, we work whether you're home or not, and text photos and a summary when the visit is done.
